repairSupportLevel.rationale: Named gluconamide pair Hydroxypropylgluconamide @11 + Hydroxypropylammonium Gluconate @12. Nominally after Parfum @8, but that marker is implausible and may not disqualify (§3.1.1 consequence 1); read on ordinal merits the pair outranks the structural fatty alcohols Lauryl Alcohol @14 / Cetyl Alcohol @15. bond_route gluconamide → high, but the above-tail position cannot be confirmed, so confidence is low and the call routes to tail_marker_unresolved review. Alternative reading (pair sub-1 % → bond_route none, repair low) is live. Comparative formula potential only: none of the bond routes has strong independent product-level substantiation at drugstore concentrations, and gluconamide bonding's own literature reports the hair mechanism as unknown.

Hydrolyzed Keratin @13 single, not a material R5 route
